policy.identity_rule: A row carrying federal_provider_no describes a Medicare-certified facility and must attach to that CCN, never create a second row for it.
policy.eligibility_rule: Senior housing is decided by care type. The registry's serves_elderly flag reads N on every skilled nursing facility and on dedicated Alzheimer homes, so it cannot carry that decision alone.
policy.derivation_rule: Endorsements are state statements and may answer a capability question. Nothing else here may be inferred into one.
